description: AlphaFold active-site geometry for Oca6, Siw14/Oca3 and Oca1: basic and acidic residues near the catalytic cysteine
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"research-agent"})
def af(acc):
    r=S.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{acc}",timeout=90)
    r.raise_for_status(); j=r.json()[0]
    url=j.get("pdbUrl")
    return S.get(url,timeout=90).text, url, j.get("latestVersion")
def parse(pdb):
    at=[]
    for l in pdb.split("\n"):
        if l.startswith("ATOM"):
            at.append(dict(name=l[12:16].strip(),res=l[17:20].strip(),num=int(l[22:26]),
                           x=float(l[30:38]),y=float(l[38:46]),z=float(l[46:54]),b=float(l[60:66])))
    return pd.DataFrame(at)
BASIC_N={"ARG":["NE","NH1","NH2"],"LYS":["NZ"],"HIS":["ND1","NE2"]}
res={}; rows=[]
for lab,acc,cys in [("Siw14","P53965",214),("Oca1","P50946",168),("Oca6","Q12454",114)]:
    pdb,url,ver=af(acc); A=parse(pdb); res[lab]=(A,cys)
    print(f"{lab} {acc} model={url.split('/')[-1]} nres={A.num.max()} meanpLDDT={A.groupby('num').b.first().mean():.1f} pLDDT(Cys{cys})={A[A.num==cys].b.iloc[0]:.1f} resid{cys}={A[A.num==cys].res.iloc[0]}")
    sg=A[(A.num==cys)&(A.name=="SG")][["x","y","z"]].values[0]
    cand=A[[ (r in BASIC_N and n in BASIC_N[r]) for r,n in zip(A.res,A.name)]].copy()
    cand["d"]=np.linalg.norm(cand[["x","y","z"]].values-sg,axis=1)
    g=cand.groupby(["num","res"]).agg(dmin=("d","min"),plddt=("b","first")).reset_index().sort_values("dmin")
    g["protein"]=lab; rows.append(g.head(8))
    print(f"  nearest basic N to Cys{cys} SG:")
    print("   "+"; ".join(f"{r.res.capitalize()}{r.num} {r.dmin:.1f}A(pLDDT {r.plddt:.0f})" for r in g.head(6).itertuples()))
    ac=A[A.res.isin(["ASP","GLU"]) & A.name.isin(["OD1","OD2","OE1","OE2"])].copy()
    ac["d"]=np.linalg.norm(ac[["x","y","z"]].values-sg,axis=1)
    ga=ac.groupby(["num","res"]).agg(dmin=("d","min"),plddt=("b","first")).reset_index().sort_values("dmin").head(4)
    print(f"  nearest acidic (general-acid candidates): "+"; ".join(f"{r.res.capitalize()}{r.num} {r.dmin:.1f}A" for r in ga.itertuples()))
    print(f"  mean pLDDT P-loop (Cys..Cys+7) = {A[(A.num>=cys)&(A.num<=cys+7)].groupby('num').b.first().mean():.1f}")
near=pd.concat(rows); near.to_csv("/tmp/af_basic.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5,4.6))
cols={"Siw14":"#4C72B0","Oca1":"#55A868","Oca6":"#C44E52"}
for i,lab in enumerate(["Siw14","Oca1","Oca6"]):
    g=near[near.protein==lab].sort_values("dmin").head(6)
    ax.scatter([i]*len(g),g.dmin,s=70,color=cols[lab],zorder=3)
    for r in g.itertuples():
        ax.annotate(f"{r.res.capitalize()}{r.num}",(i,r.dmin),xytext=(9,-3),textcoords="offset points",fontsize=8)
ax.axhline(7.0,ls="--",c="grey")
ax.text(2.45,7.2,"7 A: upper bound for a P-loop\nphosphate-binding arginine",fontsize=8,color="grey",ha="right")
ax.set_xticks(range(3)); ax.set_xlim(-0.4,2.6)
ax.set_xticklabels(["Siw14/Oca3\n(active PFA-DSP)","Oca1\n(CX5R intact)","Oca6\n(CX5R Arg absent)"])
ax.set_ylabel("distance, catalytic Cys SG to\nnearest basic side-chain N (A)")
ax.set_title("AlphaFold active sites: no basic residue replaces the missing P-loop arginine in Oca6")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
